newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends mixed on slight covering.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends mixed on slight covering.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended mixed after some marginal shortcovering for the Australian and European markets, traders said.

Australian consumers bought a total of about 200 tonnes of SMR 10 and SMR CV at 308 and 364 cents a kg, respectively, while about 10 containers of SMR10 was sold at 313.50 ringgit a kg to the German market, traders said.

"Trading is still in bits and pieces with both buyers and sellers reserved," said a trader. "Buyers are hoping that the current prices will come off while sellers are hoping they will rise because of the shortage (in supply) caused by rains.
At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted December RSS1 buyer at 320.50 cents ($1.27) a kg, unchanged from Tuesday's close. December SMR 20 was half cent lower at 308.
Traders offered the SMR CV at 366 cents, SMR L at 346, SMR 5 at 322, SMR 10 at 314, SMR 20 at 311 and drum latex at 237.
The INRO five-day moving average rose to 243.86 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Nov 26 from 244.15 on Nov 25. The daily indicator price dipped to 243.15 from 243.41.
